pages.text: Many shader packs draw their own fog at the edge of the render distance. That fog hides the cloud. Turn it off and the cloud shows up.$(br2)Look for options named Border Fog, Chunk Border Fog or Distant Fog.
pages.title: Shader packs

pages.text: Shader Pack Settings > Atmosphere > Fog > Border Fog > Off
pages.title: Complementary Reimagined

pages.text: In the fog settings, set Chunk Border Fog to Off.
pages.title: Bliss

pages.text: Option names differ between packs. Look for a setting like Border Fog, Chunk Border Fog or Distant Fog and turn it off.$(br2)Clouds drawn by a shader pack can overlap the mushroom cloud. That depends on the pack.
